selection_policy_description: For each competition/statistic, test the fixed lambda grid chronologically on pre-holdout validation folds. Rank candidates by aggregate validation combined MAE, then by lower absolute home/away bias sum, then by lower lambda. Retain the 0.05 reference lambda unless the best non-reference candidate improves combined MAE by at least the fixed material threshold.
final_holdout_policy_description: Reserve the latest readiness-approved season per competition as a final holdout while selecting lambda. Only the finally selected lambda is evaluated on that holdout after selection completes.
